collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE X: GROWING UP, GROWING OLD AND EVERYDAY JOY (LCJ-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
The rest of the owner's 100 Living Culture ideas and the world-inspired 50: secret languages and forgotten words, coming of age, elders who will not retire, healers' oaths, failed discoveries, masks and clothes and masterpieces nobody wanted, talent shows, ridiculous hats and the day nobody worked.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A researcher's public demonstration goes completely wrong: laugh it off, or try again.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) invited the whole village to see (subject.his/her) discovery: a mixture of ash and seaweed that makes fire burn hotter. In front of everyone, (subject.he/she) threw it on the fire, which made an enormous cloud of green smoke and went out completely. (friend) is trying very hard not to laugh. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) laughs, coughing green smoke. The village laughs with (subject.him/her). Afterwards, (subject.he/she) works out why it happened: the seaweed was wet. The dry version works. Nobody comes to that demonstration, but it works.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) asks for another fire and tries again, with dry seaweed. It burns blue-hot and roars. The village gasps, then cheers. (friend) says the green smoke was better.
